summary: The stated width-at-most-two product theorem follows from the supplied accepted facts with the given normalizations and constants. The mixed-face-rank cap is valid: independent centered scalar components retain the fourth-moment bound, and conditioning on all latent variables leaves a symmetric total noise, costing the factor one half only once. The original-source likelihood conversion, capacity-weighted Jensen bound, scalar surplus obtained from the auxiliary rectangle, and restoration of small and rank-zero factors establish the refined second-moment inequality; Jensen gives exactly the claimed third-moment inequality. Boundary targets, zero variances, constant projections, and empty grouped products are all covered, and the entropy-row and capacity factorizations are exact.
